recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not change the formal Vital Signs UCUM bindings for FHIR-27911 unless OO reopens the later preferred/all-UCUM R6 decisions; handle FHIR-54503's narrative consistency question separately if it reaches Applied or Published.
issue_request: FHIR-27911 was a Published/Persuasive OO technical correction for R5 asking to relax the Vital Signs UCUM common-unit binding from required to extensible for both Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x], with resolution text adding that extensions to the enumerated UCUM-code list SHOULD come from UCUM.
initial_application: Git b1bdb5bcbcff042d0e26bf061ffd5086872881fc applied the issue by adding extensible ucum-vitals-common bindings and UCUM SHOULD wording to Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x]; git 64a395a67cbd3e61bdce02c2522d32b37d8c46ff applied the same family for R4B.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and the Observation Vital Signs IG includes StructureDefinition/vitalsigns. Later Applied R6 decisions intentionally moved beyond FHIR-27911: FHIR-43353 relaxed valueQuantity/component.valueQuantity to preferred UCUM bindings, FHIR-44721 approved http://unitsofmeasure.org/vs for component.valueQuantity, and FHIR-47136 source work implemented that all-UCUM component quantity binding. FHIR-54503 later identifies narrative binding-strength wording but is still Triaged, not Applied/Published.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope Vital Signs Base Profile has a preferred ucum-vitals-common binding on Observation.value[x] and a preferred http://unitsofmeasure.org/vs binding on Observation.component.value[x]:valueQuantity; restoring FHIR-27911's exact extensible common-UCUM wording would undo later applied decisions.
